source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the scoffers' question and their claimed uninterrupted continuity.
key_decisions.before: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, everything continue as they were from the beginning of creation.”
key_decisions.after: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? Ever since our ancestors fell asleep, everything has continued as it was from the beginning of creation.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For ever since the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of creation.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves both water prepositions and deliberate overlooking without adding a cosmology.
key_decisions.before: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,
key_decisions.after: They deliberately overlook this: long ago the heavens existed, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by God's word.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For they deliberately overlook this fact, that the heavens existed long ago, and the earth was formed out of water and through water by the word of God,

key_decisions.rationale: Leaves the plural these open and keeps the watery destruction.
key_decisions.before: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished.
key_decisions.after: Through these, the world of that time was flooded with water and destroyed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and that by means of these the world that then existed was deluged with water and perished.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps the you reading, contrast of slowness and patience, and any/all scope.
key_decisions.before: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.
key_decisions.after: The Lord is not slow about the promise, as some understand slowness. He is patient with you, not wanting anyone to perish but everyone to come to repentance.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

key_decisions.rationale: Follows the pinned found/exposed reading rather than substituting burned up; ambiguity is noted.
key_decisions.before: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements will be dissolved with fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.
key_decisions.after: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief. The heavens will pass away with a roar, the elements will be dissolved by fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But the day of the Lord will come like a thief, and then the heavens will pass away with a roar, and the elements will be dissolved with fire, and the earth and the works done on it will be exposed.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps hastening alongside waiting and the repeated dissolution without harmonizing the terms.
key_decisions.before: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the elements will melt as they burn!
key_decisions.after: waiting for and hastening the coming of God's day, because of which the heavens will be dissolved in fire and the elements will melt in the heat?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: waiting for and hastening the coming of the day of God, because of which the heavens will be set on fire and dissolved, and the elements will melt as they burn!

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps difficulty in the letters explicit and preserves other Scriptures without specifying a canon list.
key_decisions.before: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.
key_decisions.after: He speaks of these things in all his letters. Some things in them are hard to understand, and the uninstructed and unstable twist them, as they do the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: as he does in all his letters when he speaks in them of these matters. There are some things in them that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unstable twist to their own destruction, as they do the other Scriptures.

key_decisions.rationale: Retains growth, full title and the unusual day-of-eternity expression.
key_decisions.before: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
key_decisions.after: Instead, grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory, both now and into the day of eternity. Amen.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be glory both now and to the day of eternity. Amen.
